reasoning_content: The `/v3/api-docs` endpoint is returning 404, which suggests SpringDoc isn't at that path or the API might be using a different endpoint. I should check the swagger configuration in the webapp and examine the Spring app's properties to understand where the API documentation is actually being served from.

action.command: echo "=== swagger redirect target for /v3/api-docs? ==="; grep -rE "api-docs|swagger" /opt/tomcat-api/webapps/xplan-manager-api/swagger-ui/swagger-init.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "=== find swagger-init.js ==="; find /opt/tomcat-api/webapps/xplan-manager-api/swagger-ui -name "*.js" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== application props ==="; unzip -p /opt/tomcat-api/webapps/xplan-manager-api.war WEB-INF/classes/application.properties 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "springdoc|swagger|api-docs" | head
